---
tag: 목소리, 톤, 영어전환, 인턴, 감탄
description: 목소리 톤, 회사 인턴에 대한 감탄 등 오늘의 회화 연습 스크립트
---

나도 모르게 영어를 쓸 때 목소리를 더 낮게 깔게 되는 경향이 있어.
```
(original) I unconsciously tend to split out more lower pitch using eng.

(corrected) I unconsciously tend to speak in a lower pitch when I use English.

(natural) My voice naturally drops when I switch to English.
```

<br><br>

가끔 어떤 사람을 보면 정말 감탄스러워. 이 얘기가 나온 이유는 요즘 우리 회사 인턴 때문이야. 그는 마치 아기 같아 — 주변의 모든 걸 스펀지처럼 흡수하거든. 맥락에서 가장 중요한 핵심을 금방 캐치하고, 궁금하면 주저 없이 물어봐. 반면에 나는 누가 내 주장이나 질문을 되물으면 확신이 안 서서 "확인해볼게"라고 하거나 계속 곱씹어봐.
```
(original) sometimes i really wonder about someones, the reasons this came up is, i picked our company's intern these days. he is like a baby. and i keep admiring him these days. cause he sponged anythings around him. he shortly catch the most important one in the context, even he never hesitate what he want to know. in my case, when i assert or ask someone something, if they ask me back about it, i'm not sure, so i say i'll check, or i chew on it.

(corrected) Sometimes I really admire certain people. The reason this came up is our company's intern these days. He's like a baby, and I keep admiring him these days because he soaks up everything around him. He quickly catches the most important point in the context, and he never hesitates to ask what he wants to know. In my case, when I assert or ask someone something, if they ask me back about it, I'm not sure, so I say I'll check, or I chew on it.

(natural) Sometimes I'm genuinely impressed by certain people. The reason this came up is our company's new intern. He's like a baby — he soaks up everything around him like a sponge. He quickly grasps the key point in any context, and he never hesitates to ask about what he wants to know. I'm the opposite, though — when someone questions me about something I claimed or asked, I get unsure, so I say I'll double-check, or I keep chewing on it, trying to answer more clearly and accurately.
```
